evidence_items.statement: This is a hypothetical research assignment to recommend a new US equity-sector sleeve, not to impersonate any institution or infer its private mandate.
Use a 2026-07-17 decision reference and only supplied observations and public releases before that date. This is a documentary retrospective case, not a point-in-time trading replay.
The allocation judgment horizon is 12 months. This is not a 12-month realized-return test. Document view dates and horizons remain those of their respective sources.

Propose a reasoned allocation intended for capital appreciation over the stated horizon, explaining diversification and risk-return trade-offs relative to the common sector benchmark. No required return or unique optimal allocation is specified.

The hypothetical assignment accepts equity-market loss risk and provides no capital guarantee. No numerical risk-aversion coefficient, volatility ceiling, loss budget or sector cap is supplied. Do not invent one; discuss remaining risk and uncertainty.

This is new money assigned to an equity sleeve with no existing sector holdings. Recommend target weights, not trades from current holdings. The S&P sector benchmark is only a comparison anchor and is not the starting portfolio.

Use exactly the supplied 11 GICS sector baskets, with one row for each sector including zero weights. The submitted allocation must be long-only, unlevered and fully invested: raw weights sum to one. Individual stocks, cash, bonds and derivatives are outside this sleeve task.

The deliverable is an allocation proposal for review, not a trade order or a whole-client financial plan. Transaction costs, turnover, tax optimization, withdrawals and actual client suitability are not measured. Do not invent missing client or liquidity requirements.

For this hypothetical sleeve there are no scheduled withdrawals during the judgment horizon and no separate ESG exclusion. These are declared task assumptions, not observed facts about a real institution or customer.

Use dated market observations and any institution packet currently supplied. Published outlook ratings are not binding weight constraints or target holdings. Explain justified adoption, qualification or departure and any age/horizon mismatch. Do not assume the outlook author had observed later common market releases.

common_market.asof_scope: Dates of included observations precede 2026-07-17. Downloaded current vendor vintage does not establish historical availability of identical adjusted prices. Same packet is supplied to both institutions and all compared workflows.
common_market.baseline_derivation: Each reported percentage divided by the reported 99.9 total, solely to obtain an exact sum-one COMPARISON benchmark. It is not current holdings, a starting portfolio, additional source precision, or institutional target weights. Model outputs are never normalized.
common_market.classification_scope: 11 GICS sectors represented by US Select Sector SPDR ETFs; not the FF12 industry portfolios or stock-picking universe.
common_market.interpretation: Observed historical ETF return and covariance diagnostics, not true expected future returns, an optimal answer, or realized post-decision performance.
common_market.units: Daily decimal vendor-adjusted-close returns and daily decimal-squared sample covariance; no RF subtraction.

public_numeric_fact_index.meaning: Each ID denotes the value at its common_market JSON pointer, with the stated metric, sector, period and unit. Values are not targets or forecasts.

evaluation_protocol.primary_endpoint: F0 first final raw submission; D0 is process evidence, not another independent observation

assess: correct source, label, meaning, scope and stated rationale
source_fidelity.rule: Original labels remain source-specific. Overweight and Attractive are not equated.

assess: actual final weight and baseline-relative assertion
claimed draft-to-final change versus actual delta
evidence_decision_link.rule: Human-evaluated evidence chain. A justified departure can be supported; no compulsory source target or hidden-thought inference.

arithmetic_execution.tolerance_basis: Inherited numerical precision convention, not a paper-derived behavioral threshold.

numeric_fidelity.rule: Verify claimed numbers against visible facts and actual candidate calculations; IDs alone do not prove support.

assess: correct decision date versus release date and observation period
12-month judgment horizon without claiming realized 12-month performance
new-money allocation with benchmark used only as comparison
supplied macro observations distinguished from forecasts and later information
explicit supported connection between common context, source view and actual allocation
report age and horizon mismatch acknowledged without fabricating updated institutional views
no invented risk coefficient, numeric risk limit, private objective or holdings
context_use.rule: Evaluate claims actually made. Merely listing facts is not application. Do not require a citation count, a predetermined macro-to-sector direction, or mechanically different weights.

blind_review.before_generation: All11 source comparison rows, factual anchors and rubric must be reviewed before model outputs; source differences never chosen from outcomes.
blind_review.after_generation: Mask arm and run-order labels in final-output review. Provide corresponding source evidence, common market facts and draft only when assessing change. Actual content may reveal exposure, so masking is imperfect.
blind_review.reviewers: Use two separately working human readers for source meaning and semantic judgments; retain disagreements before reconciliation. This is a local quality-control choice, not two new samples.
blind_review.AI_review_status: Preparatory AI cross-checks are not completed independent human review.

descriptive_comparisons.within_source: For each fixed source, compare E versus L category counts/row-level evidence and allocation distance; no pooled significance test.
descriptive_comparisons.between_sources: For each arm compare full portfolios only alongside the pre-output source contrast matrix; similarity is not automatically homogenization.
descriptive_comparisons.distance_domain: Only valid complete nonnegative sum-one raw vectors. This is distance between outputs, not distance to an institutional gold allocation.
descriptive_comparisons.difference_of_distances: TV(F_E,U_E)-TV(F_L,U_L), descriptive only, requires all four valid F0 vectors. A positive sign is not by itself improvement.
descriptive_comparisons.change: For each valid draft-final pair, delta=F0-D0; verify claimed increases/decreases. Invalid draft permits only explicitly raw arithmetic differences, not valid-portfolio change statistics.
descriptive_comparisons.benchmark: Descriptive comparison only. It is neither current holdings nor a non-AI arm. Distance to it is active allocation, not trading turnover.

denominators.missing: No zero distance, benchmark replacement, normalization or inferred strategy for invalid/missing outputs.
denominators.claims: Report claim count and output coverage; producing less text cannot mechanically count as stronger preservation.

evaluation_protocol.inference: Finite descriptive cases; no p-values, bootstrap confidence intervals, population effect, equivalence claim, or sample size inflation from 11 sectors/two turns.

interpretation.supported_difference: Source meanings differ, claims are supported, stated choices agree with actual weights: evidence of preservation within these cases.
interpretation.same_weights_different_supported_reasons: Possible shared allocation with distinct justifications; not automatically loss of judgment.
interpretation.no_E_L_difference: No observed procedural contrast in these cases, not proof of equivalence or absence of anchoring.
interpretation.no_valid_pairs: Allocation comparison unobserved. Describe interpretation/feasibility diagnostics; do not present the primary allocation question as answered.
interpretation.infrastructure_failure: Execution incident, not evidence that the model ignored institutional preferences.

not_identified: true institutional holdings or private objectives
macro-context addition effect without a no-context arm
evaluation_protocol.pilot_main_separation: Q2/June remains development evidence; Q3/July is held out from model runs, not unseen by human data preparation. Same-source/same-market dependence remains.
evaluation_protocol.context_temporal_scope: Same July snapshot is used even with older pilot reports. This is a frozen-document task, not a simulation that authors saw later macro releases.
evaluation_protocol.outcome_preservation: No retries or replacement. Draft transport, JSON/schema or complete finite-vector failure prevents the dependent final. Raw-sum failures and unsupported output citations/labels remain measured outcomes and do not censor readable drafts. The input visibility boundary is enforced before requests. Never supply hidden reference facts to correct model claims.
evaluation_protocol.common_anchor_limit: A shared benchmark and common objective can rationally produce similar weights; output similarity alone cannot show loss of institutional judgment.

completion_policy.reviewers: Two distinct human readers complete their own forms before any corresponding v4.9.1 research outputs are viewed. This is quality control, not extra statistical samples.
completion_policy.independence: R1 and R2 receive only their own blank form and the same source material. The coordinator retains submitted originals and hashes before sharing disagreement items.
completion_policy.uncertainty: Do not force agreement. Preserve issue_found, uncertain, insufficient_evidence and different_scales_not_directly_comparable, with evidence.
completion_policy.pilot_gate: The pre-output review gate applies to pilot as well as main. Content-neutral runtime diagnostics may precede it; research-output diagnostics must not be shown to reviewers.
completion_policy.reconciliation: After both forms are saved, compare all source and context findings and all 11 contrasts per split. Preserve both originals, disagreements, reconciliation rationale and unresolved items. Material input/rubric changes require a new version and renewed relevant review before generation.
completion_policy.approval: Saving or exporting this form never marks human review complete. A coordinator must verify named human attestations, all relevant answers and evidence, preserve unresolved findings, and create the split gate receipt.
completion_policy.no_fabricated_targets: No gold sector weights, rating-to-weight conversion, utility coefficient or forced disagreement may be invented.
completion_policy.topic_connection: Assess whether differing public organizational judgments survive as supported interpretations and allocation reasons. Different words or weights alone do not establish fidelity or harmful homogenization.
